description: This Swift source file defines a utility enum 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' that provides static methods for storing, retrieving, and deleting generic password data in the iOS/macOS Keychain. It encapsulates keychain query construction and interactions with Security framework functions such as SecItemAdd, SecItemCopyMatching, and SecItemDelete.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Fetches password data for a given service and account, returning it as a UTF-8 string if available.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Stores a string password for a specific service and account, with an optional accessibility attribute.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the stored password data for a specific service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Private method that retrieves raw password data from the keychain for a specified service and account.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Private method that saves raw data to the keychain for a specified service and account, with rollback on failure.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base dictionary used for keychain queries, parameterized by service and account.
